# AbstractCode

> AbstractCode is a durable terminal TUI for agentic coding on the Abstract* stack (AbstractAgent + AbstractRuntime + AbstractCore). This repo contains the published Python package (`abstractcode/`) and a separate gateway-first web host UI (`web/`).

Important notes:
- Status: **pre-alpha**, version **0.3.1** (docs last verified: 2026-02-04).
- Source of truth is the code in `abstractcode/` (and tests in `tests/`). If docs and code disagree, follow the code.
- For the authoritative in-app command list, use `/help` inside the TUI (implemented in `abstractcode/react_shell.py::_show_help`).
- The pip package is the Python CLI/TUI. The `web/` app is a separate Node/Vite build (see [docs/web.md](docs/web.md)).
- Rebuilding `web/` currently requires a sibling `abstractuic/` repo via Vite path aliases; `web/dist/` is included for convenience.
- Tools are **approval-gated by default** (see [docs/cli.md](docs/cli.md)).
- The web host includes optional voice UX (record/transcribe + TTS playback) when the gateway host has `abstractvoice` installed and capabilities are enabled.
- Local VisualFlow runs via `abstractcode flow ...` require the optional extra `abstractcode[flow]` (see [docs/workflows.md](docs/workflows.md)).
- `llms-full.txt` contains a single-file snapshot of the core docs/policies (it does not inline source code).
- Dev loop: `pytest -q` (tests), `ruff check .` (lint), `black .` (format).

## Key code entry points

- [CLI entrypoint](abstractcode/cli.py): argparse + subcommand dispatch
- [Interactive host](abstractcode/react_shell.py): TUI loop, approvals, MCP integration, persistence
- [Workflow agent](abstractcode/workflow_agent.py): `abstractcode.agent.v1` VisualFlow agent mode
- [Local flow runner](abstractcode/flow_cli.py): `abstractcode flow ...` implementation
- [Gateway client](abstractcode/gateway_cli.py): `/api/gateway/*` HTTP client
- [Workflow bundle CLI](abstractcode/workflow_cli.py): install/list/remove `.flow` bundles on a gateway
- [Web gateway client](web/src/lib/gateway_client.ts): browser client for `/api/gateway/*`
